title: Sandra is the BEST!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text: Sandra was the absolutely most wonderful tour guide ever! She took us everywhere and was so incredibly patient. She was a complete delight. So knowledgeable and gracious with her time! We just loved our day because of the most beautiful attractions but even more because we got to spend the day with Sandra. Please let her know we just thought the world of her. A raise is in order. She truly deserves it.
author: George_V
